name: Adun Oakenshield
description: A figure whose passing the Anvilonian Grimoire says will cause the world's great warriors to rise and follow him.

description_citations.text: Masters Edition: card flavor text (Masters Edition, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A warrior whose passing will raise the bodies of the world's great warriors to follow him to battle.
